Alex: heads-up — after last runtime push we saw a 12-18% throughput drop on NVLink 8‑GPU racks for tp=2 models. suspect kernel selection + KV cache prefetch ordering. first noticed on perf-run 1919989000. :thinking:
Maria: can you paste the flame/trace? which nodes/fabric?
Alex: running on nvlink-ccx (DGX-style). trace excerpt:
```
PROFILE: model=redwood-6b-tp2
kernel_select: fmha_fast @ 1.0ms -> fallback matmul @ 3.4ms
AllReduce: avg=3.8ms (was 1.1ms)
KVCache prefetch: triggered early, blocked compute for 4 batches
batching: dynamic_batcher slice_size=256 -> increased small allreduces
```
Maria: whoa AllReduce jumped. Did nettopo change? any MIGs? :eyes:
PerfBot: deploy 2026-03-17T11:02Z to runtime-v2 completed by ci/cd
Tim: I think the kernel selector heuristic now prefers matmul for small seq len when tile_sz mismatch. That increases compute and forces earlier all-reduce sync. Try forcing fmha_fast in config:
```
runtime.conf:
  kernel_selector:
    override: ['fmha_fast']
  batch_slicing: true
  batch_slicing_threshold: 1024
```
Sanjay: also check comm schedule — we moved to hierarchical allreduce for cross-node last week. On NVLink the intra-node fan reduces are cheap but our schedule inserts an extra cross-node step before compute overlap. Try ring instead:
```
bench run --nodes=8 --fabric=nvlink --allreduce=ring --tp=2 --seed=42
```
Alex: ran ring + fmha override: throughput +14%, median latency -9%. but on PCIe nodes no change. suggests topology-aware routing missing. copying perf diff:
```
baseline (hierarchical): tokens/s=1120, allreduce_avg=3.8ms
trial (ring+fmha):    tokens/s=1276, allreduce_avg=1.3ms
```
Maria: ok can we add a topo probe at startup to pick allreduce algorithm? maybe use NVLINK adjacency to choose ring intra-node and hierarchical inter-node. Add fallback if KV cache hotness < 3.
Tim: I'll sketch a patch. simple heuristic: if intra-node bandwidth > 10x inter-node, select intra-ring then inter-hier. also defer KV prefetch until after first compute if tp_shards>1.
Sanjay: can we run smoke across PCIe and EFA clusters? I'll set up 4x runs with fabric override. I'll post scripts in #perf.
Alex: thanks. action items: Tim to PR kernel selector override + kvprefetch flag, Sanjay to run cross-fabric smoke, Maria to add probe metric. I'll collect new traces. :rocket:
PerfBot: perf/bench results uploaded: s3://redwood-perf/1919990000/summary.json
Maria: saved. great work team. :thumbsup:
